long_biography.plain_text:
Riley entered telecommunications after leaving school at sixteen, beginning as a trainee fax-machine engineer before moving into sales. He founded Daisy in 2001 to serve smaller UK businesses with communications services independent of any single network. The company grew organically and through acquisitions, entered the public market, and later returned to private ownership.

A new phase began in August 2025, when Daisy Group and Virgin Media O2 Business formed O2 Daisy. The combination joined Daisy's service platforms with Virgin Media O2's fixed and mobile infrastructure, with Riley as chairman. Rebranded O2 Business the following year, the company remains centered on connectivity, communications and managed IT. Riley's other board and investment roles are secondary to the founder-led telecoms career that created and continues to define his business position.
